rv.q: The effect, in Matthew Lenton’s high-precision production, is to turn a stressful night on the wards into something like gothic horror.
The piece is visually arresting and uncompromising in its depiction of Flora's internal conflict and the ill-fated state of her external environment.
An odd emotional lacuna in the script by Josephine Eusebius ultimately limits the drama’s impact, however.

cn.t: This visually striking international collaboration between Scottish and Danish companies delivers a darkly styled hospital drama, with critics praising its bold design choices while finding the execution somewhat uneven.
